prerequisite: Both shared communicating and SignCraft parsers already allow generic verb + do ve + embedded clause structure; no existing corpus item was found using nes with ccomp.

signcraftDenialSubstrate.representation: formal context with positive incidence pairs plus separate denial pairs
signcraftDenialSubstrate.derivedReading: negative-lane support can settle a cell to active; positive+negative support can settle to stable
signcraftDenialSubstrate.property: denial is additive and local; it does not erase positive evidence or explode contradiction

contrasts.surface: mi ga nes do ve tu ga ran do sava.
contrasts.parseTarget: matrix nes event with ccomp to embedded ran(tu,sava)
contrasts.candidateDialogueSemantics: metalinguistic denial report concerning the embedded proposition
contrasts.candidateEvidencePolicy: report-only by default; an explicit policy may promote the authenticated denial report to an against-side witness for the embedded proposition
contrasts.mustNot: replace or delete existing for-side evidence

contrasts.surface: mi ga nul do ve tu ga ran do sava.
contrasts.parseTarget: matrix nul event with ccomp to embedded ran(tu,sava)
contrasts.candidateEvidencePolicy: never infer that the embedded proposition is false merely from refusal
contrasts.mustNot: populate the target proposition's against side solely because it was refused

contrasts.candidateDialogueSemantics: lexical/metalinguistic negation of a nominal relation object
contrasts.caution: do not silently reinterpret every nes clause as logical negation of a proposition

evaluation: both parsers accept/refuse each form and preserve ccomp identity
proposition nucleus of embedded P is stable across positive assertion and denial-report contexts
denial report and refusal report remain distinct resources
optional evidential promotion adds only an against witness and derives active/stable through SignCell/SignChain rather than assigning a stored FOUR value
